answer: Referral graph: honest vs forged. Honest: a verified referrer locks 100 units for 12 epochs and vouches for at most 3 per epoch. Forged: 1,000 fakes need referrers too, and a star cluster — one referrer behind hundreds of newcomers — is auto-flagged, freezing the chain. Honest cost: 100 units locked, freed after 12 clean epochs. Forged cost: 34 clean referrers lock 3,400 units; at a 40% flag rate the loss is 13,600 units, plus a 10-epoch vouching ban. The lagoon dries up: pigment analysis spots the star pattern, the walnut-hard shape of forgery.
